use IO.Std.write_line

union Shape is
    CIRCLE(radius: double)
    RECTANGLE(width: double, height: double)
    TRIANGLE(base: double, height: double)
si

area(shape: Shape) -> double =>
    case shape
    when c: Shape.CIRCLE then c.radius * c.radius * 3.14159
    when r: Shape.RECTANGLE then r.width * r.height
    when t: Shape.TRIANGLE then t.base * t.height / 2.0
    esac

describe(shape: Shape) -> string =>
    case shape
    when c: Shape.CIRCLE then "circle of radius {c.radius}"
    when r: Shape.RECTANGLE then "{r.width} by {r.height} rectangle"
    when t: Shape.TRIANGLE then "triangle {t.base} by {t.height}"
    esac

let shapes: Shape[] =
    [Shape.CIRCLE(2.0), Shape.RECTANGLE(3.0, 4.0), Shape.TRIANGLE(5.0, 6.0)]

for shape in shapes do
    write_line("{describe(shape)}: area {area(shape)}")
